reviews.title_after: A localized dust storm blinds drivers near Rexford, Kansas
reviews.location_after: Highway 83 near Rexford, Thomas County, Kansas
reviews.core_fact: A localized blowing-dust event caused severe visibility reductions near Rexford, Kansas, on January 16, 2014, contributing to traffic crashes.
reviews.source_dependence: NCEI county report and NWS Goodland annual retrospective describe the same incident, likely drawing upon the same original NWS storm-report information.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Avoid independent-observation claims or unsupported exact crash/fatality numbers; this was a localized dust plume, not necessarily a regionwide haboob.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Rexford and Highway 83 road/location map with winds and visibility observations

reviews.title_before: Extreme Cold/Wind Chill — QUEENS, New York
reviews.title_after: An atmospheric river brings damaging wind and flooding to California
reviews.location_after: Bay Area, Los Angeles region and California coast
reviews.core_fact: A strong atmospheric river began affecting much of California with heavy rainfall and strong winds on February 4, 2024, during a multiday February 4–6 storm.
reviews.source_dependence: UCSD CW3E event analysis and contemporary Associated Press reporting corroborate the date/region; some observations trace to shared weather networks.
reviews.unverified_cautions: CW3E rain totals and peak gusts are multi-day event values, not daily Feb 4 amounts; effects and landslides extended into Feb 5–6.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original February 4 vapor-transport and California observed flooding map

reviews.title_after: Icelandic volcanic ash keeps European airspace closed
reviews.location_after: United Kingdom and northern Europe; ash from Iceland
reviews.core_fact: Volcanic ash continued to disrupt UK air travel on April 17, 2010, when weather patterns retained ash over the region.
reviews.source_dependence: UK CAA dated April 17 flight-restriction timeline and NASA April 17 MODIS ash imagery corroborate distinct institutional observations.
reviews.unverified_cautions: The ash-rich eruptive phase began April 14 and flight restrictions began April 15; April 17 is ash persistence/disruption, not eruption onset. Volcanology differs from atmospheric transport.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original ash-transport and UK airport disruption timing diagram

reviews.title_after: Canadian wildfire smoke turns New York City's skies orange
reviews.location_after: New York City and northeastern United States
reviews.core_fact: On June 7, 2023, Canadian wildfire smoke caused hazardous surface air quality around New York City; NASA satellite images show smoke entering New York and Pennsylvania that morning.
reviews.source_dependence: NASA GOES image and NYC contemporaneous air quality briefing corroborate date and smoke impacts using separate sources, though satellite imagery and ground AQI measure different quantities.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Do not conflate June 6 arrival with June 7 peak, or regionwide AQI with single-station hourly PM2.5; visual image licenses require separate clearance.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original smoke-plume trajectory and NYC monitor-specific hourly air-quality plot

reviews.title_after: Hurricane Bertha makes landfall along the Cape Fear coast
reviews.location_after: Wilmington and southeastern North Carolina coast
reviews.core_fact: Hurricane Bertha reached the North Carolina coast near Wilmington on July 12, 1996.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS Wilmington case history and NC State Climate Office landfall table establish the date/area, but intensity and center-fix data ultimately originate with hurricane best-track analysis.
reviews.unverified_cautions: Sources differ in their shorthand for exact landfall position; use near Wilmington/Cape Fear pending best-track comparison. Bertha's earlier peak intensity is not landfall intensity.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Bertha track with landfall and dated coastal observations

reviews.title_after: The Plainfield F5 tornado devastates Chicago's southwest suburbs
reviews.location_after: Plainfield, Crest Hill and Joliet, Illinois
reviews.core_fact: A violent F5 tornado struck Plainfield, Crest Hill and Joliet in northeastern Illinois on August 28, 1990.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS storm reconstruction and CDC's 1990 field epidemiological investigation independently document timing and affected locations, though F rating derives from historical Fujita damage survey.
reviews.unverified_cautions: F5 is the historical rating, not EF5. Verify exact damage swath and original warning chronology; do not mix outbreak totals with this tornado.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original surveyed Plainfield to Crest Hill tornado path and warning-timing diagram

reviews.title_after: An extraordinary October tornado outbreak strikes northern Arizona
reviews.core_fact: Multiple tornadoes struck northern Arizona near Bellemont and Flagstaff on October 6, 2010, in one of the state's most unusual tornado outbreaks.
reviews.source_dependence: NWS Flagstaff retrospective documents tornado tracks; same-day KNAU reporting documents impacts independently, but initial touchdown counts were preliminary and derived partly from public-safety reporting.
reviews.unverified_cautions: The NWS retrospective says at least 11 while early reports said 3 or 4; never compare those as competing final totals. Original Kachina alternate belongs to same outbreak; replace it.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original northern Arizona separate tornado-track map and radar timeline

reviews.title_after: Dangerous arctic wind chills grip the Chicago region
reviews.core_fact: Arctic temperatures and dangerous wind chills affected Chicago and northern Illinois on December 21, 2008, as winter storms swept the Midwest.
reviews.source_dependence: Original NCEI Cook County record and Purdue MRCC synoptic Dec 15–21 review corroborate conditions but share underlying station observations.
reviews.unverified_cautions: NCEI cold episode runs Dec 21–25; do not attribute multiday cold fatalities to one day. Separate wind chills, air temperatures and nearby blizzard effects.
reviews.graphic_concept: Original Chicago temperature and wind-chill and Midwest frontal evolution

alternate_reviews.caution: Original Kachina Village tornado alternate is same Oct 6, 2010 synoptic outbreak as now-selected primary; October 6 Bahamas Matthew is distinct from October 7 Volusia impacts.
